menu_options.tracking: Track a parcel without an account

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate My bpost
reauth_confirm.description: Your My bpost session expired. Enter your password again.

account.title: My bpost account
account.description: Log in with your My bpost email and password. Parcels linked to your account are discovered automatically.

tracking.title: Public parcel tracking
tracking.description: Enter the barcode and delivery postal code. One parcel is added per entry; no My bpost account is required.

bulk.title: Add several parcels
bulk.description: Paste one barcode per line (maximum 20). The postal code and group apply to every line. Valid parcels are added; duplicates are skipped.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the My bpost service.
error.invalid_tracking: Enter a valid barcode and postal code.
error.tracking_not_found: No parcel found. Check the barcode and delivery postal code; a new label may not be visible yet.
error.rate_limited: bpost requested a pause. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This account or parcel is already configured.
abort.bulk_complete: Added: {added}. Already configured: {existing}. Failed rows: {failed}. Check their barcode and postal code, or try again later.

init.title: Tracking options
init.description: Checks eligible deliveries at most once per minute, with a limit of two requests per account per minute.

data_description.enable_mail_images: Images are fetched only when viewed. Envelope scans can contain names and addresses.

tracking_options.title: Parcel options
tracking_options.description: Edit the delivery postal code or display name. Remove this integration entry to stop tracking the parcel.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the My bpost service.
error.invalid_tracking: Enter a valid barcode and postal code.
error.tracking_not_found: No parcel found. Check the barcode and delivery postal code; a new label may not be visible yet.

track_parcels.name: Track parcels
track_parcels.description: Add up to 20 manual parcels and return a result per row.

parcels.name: Parcels
parcels.description: List of 1–20 objects with barcode and postal_code; optional label, group, direction and app_lang.

untrack_parcels.name: Stop tracking parcels
untrack_parcels.description: Remove only the selected manual entries.

entry_ids.name: Entry IDs
entry_ids.description: IDs of manual entries returned by track_parcels; account entries are refused.

get_summary.name: Parcel summary
get_summary.description: Count parcels without duplicates in the Home Assistant time zone.

entry_id.name: Entry (optional)
entry_id.description: Limit the summary to one integration entry.

group.name: Group
group.description: Exact local group name; empty includes every group.
